COMPLETE LIST OF APPLICANTS CALLED FOR INTERVIEW FOR VARIOUS GROUP D POSTS VIDE ADVERTISEMENT NO. 05/2013 DATED 19-08-2013 BY DEPARTMENTAL SELECTION COMMITTEE,
FOREST DEPARTMENT, HARYANA.
In reference to the Advertisement No. 05/2013 dated 19-08-2013 for selection of 170 VARIOUS GROUP D POSTS OF MALI / CHOWKIDAR / PEON / MALI - CUM - CHOWKIDAR ( WL ) / PEON-CUM- CHOWKIDAR
( WL ) / KEEPER ( WL ) / PEON ( WL ) / CHOWKIDAR ( WL ) in Haryana Forest Department in various reserved and unreserved categories, large number of applications were received from candidates. Candidates
were shortlisted for interview as per eligibility criteria mentioned in the Advertisement No. DSC 07/2013 dated 02-12-2013. On the basis of the interview held in December 2013, the result was published on
dated 03-07-2014. The detailed result with Marks in Academics and Interview is given below:
Note 1: The appointment of the Ex Service Men (ESM) are provisional subject to submission of latest Eligibility Certificates issued by competent authorities/ Zila Sainik Board at the time of joining in the Forest
Department.
Note 2: The selection of candidates are provisional subject to verification of records at the time of joining. The selected candidates have not been medically examined and no special inquiry into their
antecedents has been made. The documents pertaining to their qualifications, age and caste/category as claimed by them, in their applications forms, will be checked/verified from the issuing authorities, if
need be, before they are allowed to join their duties.
Note 3: Only those experience certificate for the post of Mali have been considered which were issued by competent authorities/ agencies as per the advertsement. Certificates issued by unregistered private
nurseries and other agencies unrelated to the growing of seedlings in nurseries and management of nurseries have been rejected.The decision of the Interview board members examining the experience
certificate is final. The experience certificates may be verified from the issuing agency by the appointing authority, if need be.
Note 5: In view of large number of applications received from Ex-Service Man (ESM), Dependent Ex-Service Man (DESM) and wards of Freedom Fighter in General, BC-A, BC-B,SC have been considered in their
respective Categories (General, BC-A, BC-B SC,) as applicable provided they fulfill all eligibility criteria for that category.
Note 6: In case more than one candidate in a category have got equal aggregiate marks (academic + interview) then the older candidate has been ranked senior to younger candidate
Note 7: Although every care has been taken in preparing the following information, possibility of inadvertent errors cannot be ruled out. The Selection Committee reserves the right to rectify the same later on.
Note 8: Since the applications were filled online by the candidates giving required information (marks in academics, experience, etc.) and were shortlisted for interview but were not found eligible later on by
the Interview Board on the basis of any criteria fixed by the Departmental Selection Committee, such candidates were not awarded any marks in interview.
THE LIST IS IN ORDER OF ROLL NUMBER.
